slice: PR 1 of 3: the touch D-pad as DOM over the Pixi stage, held by pointer with capture, emitting GameController.setControl as the keyboard does, released on pointerup, pointercancel, lostpointercapture, window blur and visibilitychange; 44px targets with 8px spacing, safe-area offsets, and the dive filling a landscape phone screen

prereviewPass3.finding: during a rebreather safety stop the German stop row wraps to two lines, so an open page ended 19 px lower and met the hint at 461 px (-4 px); any height threshold is beaten by the next taller HUD
change: no height threshold for the hint: src/app/controls-hint.ts measures it against the HUD list and the gas-information panel and hides it while it would come within 8 px of either; a ResizeObserver on the HUD, the panel, the dock and the shell re-measures on every size change, and opening or closing a page re-measures at once

an open gas-information page hides the in-dive buttons (D-pad, torch, fast-forward, cylinders, rebreather row), as legacy hides them while showGasInfo (src/touch.js updateNavPadVisibility, updateCcrDiveButtonVisibility, touchUpdateUI); brought forward from #168 PR 3 because the worst-case test found an open page 3 px into the setpoint buttons at 844x390, which no layout of that screen avoids
prereviewPass3.worstCaseTest: tests/in-dive-controls.spec.js 'wherever the hint is shown, it stands 8px clear of the HUD and an open page': German, rebreather, resumed at 9 m from 20 m with its safety stop paused at 2 min 52 sec (the codec requires a started stop to be paused exactly outside the 2.4-8.3 m band; 9 m is neutral so the diver stays), the gas page closed and then open, at 1280x720, 600, 585, 520, 480, 473, 465, 461, 446, 932x430 and 844x390; every size asserts the hint hidden or 8 px clear and the HUD and page clear of every control; the hint is asserted kept at 1280x720 closed and gone at 844x390 open
prereviewPass3.notCovered: the rule-of-thirds row: it shows only under an overhead and is cleared outside one, so it cannot appear with this resumed open-water dive; the measuring rule does not depend on which rows are shown

tests.result: 85 passed, 1 failed: the new 'an open page hides the in-dive buttons' case expected 6 buttons where a rebreather shows 8 (four directions, torch, two setpoint, bailout); corrected, it passed alone with one worker
